assembly_doctrine.source_layer: The unchanged 1879 source-scoped profile governs the exact nominal thirty-nazhigai half, samams, cell sequence, and rational activity offsets.
assembly_doctrine.astronomical_layer: The admitted Stage 2A local-solar context governs the containing solar half, weekday, schedule selection, sunrise anchor, sunset anchor, and solar half end.
assembly_doctrine.clock_layer: One nazhigai is the modern explicitly sourced fixed unit of 1440 SI seconds. Exact rational nominal offsets are added to the reader-bound TT representation of the selected half start, and each endpoint is projected back to UT1.
assembly_doctrine.anchor_rule: Day starts at the governing topocentric sunrise; night starts at the governing topocentric sunset.
assembly_doctrine.boundary_rule: Every materialized cell is half-open; an exact cell endpoint belongs to the next cell, while the fixed half endpoint is excluded.
assembly_doctrine.fixed_end_rule: Thirty nazhigai always materializes as 43200 SI seconds on reader-bound TT.
assembly_doctrine.solar_end_rule: The materialized fixed end is never clipped or stretched to the astronomical sunset or next sunrise.
assembly_doctrine.topology_rule: Classify the signed fixed-end minus solar-end difference as before, coalescent, or after, with absolute differences no greater than 0.0001 second treated as coalescent.
assembly_doctrine.current_cell_rule: Do not select or claim a current schedule cell; a requested instant may lie outside the fixed span even while it remains inside the governing solar half.
assembly_doctrine.polar_policy: Fail explicitly when lawful sunrise and sunset bounds do not exist.

authority_and_provenance.historical_source_attestation: The named 1879 witness attests only the exact nominal thirty-nazhigai schedule and offsets used by the unchanged profile; the SI-second projection and astronomical composition are not attributed to it.

public_claim: Given an explicit profile, UT1 instant, location, and caller-supplied Purva or Amara source label, resolve the governing local-solar half and nominal schedule, anchor it at that half's sunrise or sunset, add its exact nazhigai offsets as fixed SI seconds on reader-bound TT, project all half-open endpoints to UT1, and expose the unclipped fixed-end topology against the astronomical half end.

clipping or stretching the fixed schedule to the astronomical half
solar-proportional or seasonal scaling of nominal durations
historical source attestation for the modern SI-second and astronomical composition policy
astronomical or lunar inference of Purva or Amara paksha
condition evaluation, scoring, or electional window search
cross-witness normalization or corroborated public status
a universal or default Pancha Pakshi canon
